g.text: The parameter DataSource picks where GoldTable(name) reads; the six table queries, measures and RLS do not change.
From Databricks only ReportFromYear (2021) onwards is read; the filter folds to the warehouse.
The warehouse starts on the first query of a refresh and stops on its own when idle.
